gloss: first half; first term; earlier period

definitions.gloss: first half; first term; first period
definitions.explanation: The first of two halves of a defined time span. Commonly used for academic semesters, fiscal periods, and historical eras.

examples.japanese: {前期|ぜんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The grades for the first semester came out.

examples.japanese: {前期|ぜんき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧だった。
examples.english: Sales in the first half were strong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧{前期|ぜんき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{町人|ちょうにん}→町人：13593_chounin⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{栄|さか}えた→栄える：13104_sakaeru⟧。
examples.english: In the early Edo period, merchant-class culture flourished.

notes:
Refers to the first of two halves of a time period. Commonly encountered in academic (semester), business (fiscal half), and historical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前期|ぜんき}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: first-semester exam
- {前期|ぜんき}⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧: first-half financial results
- {前期|ぜんき}⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧: compared to the previous period
- {前期|ぜんき}⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧: first-term program (e.g., master's program in graduate school)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後期|こうき}→後期：12603_kouki⟧: second half, latter term — the counterpart of {前期|ぜんき}
- ⟦{上半期|かみはんき}→上半期：20412_kamihanki⟧: first half of the year (specifically January–June or April–September)
- ⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧: first half (more general; used for games, events, etc.)
